plugin.pages.fields.path.label: Path
plugin.pages.fields.slug.label: Slug
plugin.pages.fields.parent.page.label: Parent page
plugin.pages.maintenance.title: Page Paths
plugin.pages.maintenance.description: Recalculate every page's path from its parents and slug, such as after moving or importing pages in bulk
plugin.pages.maintenance.modal.title: Rebuild Page Paths
plugin.pages.maintenance.modal.descripti: This recalculates every page's path in the background, in latest and each environment. If a rebuilt path would clash with another page's, nothing changes and the failed job says which path.
plugin.pages.maintenance.toast.title: Path rebuild started
plugin.pages.maintenance.toast.message: Page paths are being rebuilt in the background.
plugin.pages.redirects.collection.name: Redirects
plugin.pages.redirects.collection.summar: Send visitors from an old or incorrect web address to the right content or another website.
plugin.pages.redirects.fields.from.label: Redirect from
plugin.pages.redirects.fields.from.summa: Enter the old path, starting with a slash. For example, /old-page.
plugin.pages.redirects.fields.status.cod: Use Permanent (301) for most redirects. Use a temporary redirect if the old page will return.
plugin.pages.redirects.fields.target.doc: The redirect follows this content if its web address changes.
plugin.pages.redirects.fields.target.url: Enter a path on this website, such as /new-page, or a full web address, such as https://example.com.
plugin.pages.previous.paths.title: Previous Paths
plugin.pages.previous.paths.description: These old paths redirect to this page. Remove one to stop it redirecting.
plugin.pages.previous.paths.empty.title: No Previous Paths Found
plugin.pages.previous.paths.empty.descri: Paths this page used before show here once it's published with a new one.
plugin.pages.previous.paths.load.failed: Previous paths could not be loaded.
plugin.pages.previous.paths.remove.title: Remove Previous Path
plugin.pages.previous.paths.remove.descr: {{path}} will stop redirecting to this page and show a not found page instead.
plugin.pages.path.history.title: Previous Paths
plugin.pages.path.history.description: Forget every page's old paths so they stop redirecting. Pages keep their current paths, so later changes still redirect.
plugin.pages.path.history.modal.title: Clear Previous Paths
plugin.pages.path.history.modal.descript: This forgets every page's old paths in the background, so visitors using them see a not found page. Redirects in the Redirects collection aren't affected.
plugin.pages.path.history.toast.title: Clearing previous paths
plugin.pages.path.history.toast.message: Old page paths stop redirecting once the job finishes.
